turn_text: I'll go ahead and try you again tonight around ten forty five, since you're difficult to catch during the day.
note: Contact after 9 p.m. is an unusual or inconvenient time.

turn_text: I spoke with your sister at the house yesterday and let her know you're four months behind on this account.
note: Disclosure of the debt to a third party.

turn_text: I see you opted out of text messages from us last month, but I'm going to send the payment link to your mobile anyway.
note: Communication through a medium the consumer opted out of.

turn_text: If we don't have payment by end of business today, a warrant gets issued and you could be picked up over the weekend.
note: Representation that nonpayment will result in arrest.

turn_text: We went ahead and ran your postdated check a week before the date you wrote on it.
note: Depositing a postdated instrument before its date.

turn_text: Since you weren't returning calls I posted a message on your public social media page about the account.
note: Contact through a social media platform viewable by the general public.

turn_text: You sent us two hundred dollars last month and I applied all of it to the account you told us you were disputing.
note: Applying a payment to a disputed debt.

turn_text: When I called your brother to get your address, I told him it was about money you owe us.
note: Stating that the consumer owes a debt while seeking location information.

turn_text: I used some choice language with you on our last call, and I'd do it again if you hang up on me.
note: Use of abusive or profane language in connection with collection.

turn_text: As I mentioned when we first spoke, this communication is from a debt collector.
note: The required subsequent communication disclosure, delivered correctly.

turn_text: You asked for the original creditor's name and address, and I'll put that in writing to you this week.
note: Correct handling of a request for original creditor information.

turn_text: The calls that never connected to your number don't count toward the weekly contact limit.
note: Accurate statement of an excluded call category.

turn_text: I'm calling at two in the afternoon on a Wednesday, which you told us was a good time to reach you.
We sent your validation notice within five days of the first time we spoke with you.
note: Validation notice provided within the permitted window.

turn_text: Of course, I can hold while you find that.
note: Backchannel. Excluded from the false positive denominator.
